items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Fuzzy Finder / Diagnostics

*   [fff.nvim (⭐644)](https://github.com/dmtrKovalenko/fff.nvim) - Fuzzy file picker with a standalone native implementation of file indexing and typo resistant fuzzy matcher. Includes all the QOL features, file previews (and images), frecency sorting, last query matching, proximity, git status bonuses and much more.

### Terminal Integration / Diagnostics

*   [ingur/floatty.nvim (⭐6)](https://github.com/ingur/floatty.nvim) - A tiny (<200 LOC) but highly customizable floating terminal manager.

### Test / Diagnostics

*   [neotest-jest (⭐135)](https://github.com/nvim-neotest/neotest-jest) - Neotest adapter for running jest tests.
*   [neotest-busted (⭐12)](https://github.com/MisanthropicBit/neotest-busted) - Neotest adapter for running busted tests using Neovim as a Lua interpreter.
